data.description: Full Sea View | Brand New | Spacious
data.display_address: Seagate Building 3, Seagate, Mina Rashid, Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident is proud to present to you this brand new 2-bedroom luxury residence at Seagate Rashid Yachts & Marina.

From the living/dining area & master bedroom you have stunning SEA VIEWS. The floor to ceiling windows let in tons of natural daylight, giving the apartment the absolute WoW factor.

The master bedroom is spacious and has a private ensuite bathroom for that extra luxury you deserve.

The apartment:

-Full Sea View from the living/dining area & master bedroom
-2 bedroom (brand new)
-1,200.61 sq.ft (111.54 sq.m)
-2 bath
-Laundry room
-1 basement parking included

Amenities:

-50 meters from seaside promenade
-500-meter canal pool (swimming pool)
-Gym
-24/7 reception & security
-Residence lounge
-Spinney’s supermarket & Roasters specialty coffee café on ground floor
-Café`s & restaurants within walking distance

Location

-10 min to La Mer/Jumeirah
-10 min to Downtown/DIFC
-15 min to DXB airport

Rashid Yachts & Marina is a waterfront development with its own marina and also features a 500-meter swimming pool for residents. The community has a a variety of restaurants & cafés, offices and much more. And is only a 10-minute drive from the Dubai Mall and La Mer/Jumeirah.

You need a little bit of Rashid Yachts & Marina in your life, Discover Dubai your way at Seagate Rashid Yachts & Marina.
